title: Smoky Dolmades
description: A twist on traditional dolmades, these smoky stuffed grape leaves are filled with a hearty vegetable mix and served as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Soak grape leaves in water for 10 minutes.
Combine zucchini, bell peppers, onions, rice, tomato paste, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Drain grape leaves and place a tablespoon of the vegetable mix in the center of each leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll into a neat package.
Place the dolmades seam-side down in a baking dish and cover with a lid.
Steam the dolmades over boiling water for 20-25 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
